table.retrieve:
select icode=code10,
			saleqty = code1,
			saleval=value1,
			saltisfyqty=code2,
			satisfyval=value2, 
			saleretqty=code3,
			SaleReturnval=value3,
			purchaseqty=code4,
			purval=value4,
			purchasereturnqty=code5,
			PurRetVal=value5,
			adjincreaseqty=code6,
			AdjIncreaseVal=value6,
			adjdecreaseqty=code7,
			AdjDecreaseVal=value7,
			Issueqty=code8,
			Issueval=value8,
			receiptqty=code9,
			receiptval=value9,
			itemname=name1,
			alisname=name2,
			active=(SELECT CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM ITEM WHERE Item.ICODE = reportdata.Code10),
			/*category=itemcategory.name,*/
			category=(select name from itemcategory where icatcode=reportdata.code11),
			saleprice=(select Round(saleprice/CASE WHEN PackUnits > 0 THEN PackUnits ELSE 1 END,2) from item where item.icode=reportdata.code10),
			
			
               
			itemopeningstock= (select isnull(sum(Case When purledger.purcatcode IN (3, 7, 8)  THEN
                        							 purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty
															 Else (purdetail.packqty  + purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.packunits 
                                              END),0)
									from purdetail,purledger 
									where purledger.postdate < :ar_StartDate and 
											purledger.posted='Y'and
		     							   purledger.purinvcode=purdetail.purinvcode and
		      							purdetail.icode=reportdata.code10
		  									 ) 

									-

		

	     						(select isnull(sum(saledetail.looseqty),0) from saledetail,saleledger 
		 							where saleledger.date < :ar_StartDate and 
		      							saleledger.saleinvcode=saledetail.saleinvcode and
                                 saledetail.due IS NULL and
		       							saledetail.icode=reportdata.code10)
								-
								(select isnull(sum(duesatisfydetail.duesatisfyqty),0) from duesatisfyheader,duesatisfydetail
								 where duesatisfyheader.duesatisfydate<:ar_Startdate and
										 duesatisfyheader.duesatisfycode=duesatisfydetail.duesatisfycode and
										 duesatisfydetail.icode=reportdata.code10)
											
	     						- 
								
								(select isnull(sum(issuedetail.qty),0) from issuedetail , issueheader
	        						where    issueheader.date < :ar_StartDate and 
	        									issueheader.issueinvcode=issuedetail.issueinvcode and 
												issuedetail.icode=reportdata.code10)
								 +

								(select isnull(sum(receiptdetail.qty),0) from receiptdetail , receiptheader
	        						where    receiptheader.date < :ar_StartDate and 
												receiptheader.posted='Y' and
	        									receiptheader.receiptinvcode=receiptdetail.receiptinvcode and 
												receiptdetail.icode=reportdata.code10)
								
								 +

								(select isnull(sum(Case when adjheader.adjcatcode=1 then
			    									 adjdetail.looseqty 
											ELSE 
			      								(-1) * adjdetail.looseqty
											END ),0)
	      					from adjdetail,adjheader 
	     						where adjheader.date <:ar_StartDate  and
		    							adjheader.adjcode=adjdetail.adjcode and
		   							adjdetail.icode=Reportdata.code10)
	    						 +


								(select isnull(sum(srdetail.looseqty),0) from srdetail,srledger 
								 where srledger.date < :ar_StartDate and 
										srledger.srinvcode=srdetail.srinvcode and 
										srdetail.icode=reportdata.code10)
	    						 -



								(select isnull(sum(prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.bonusqty),0)
	      						from prdetail,prledger 
	      						where prledger.date < :ar_StartDate and
		    								prledger.prinvcode=prdetail.prinvcode and
		    								prdetail.icode=reportdata.code10)
from reportdata

where reportdata.code11 IN (:ar_manfcode)
		/*reportdata.code11=itemcategory.icatcode*/
order by category,
			reportdata.name1

objects.name: compute_15
objects.expression: sum(( itemopeningstock  +  saleretqty  +  purchaseqty  +  adjincreaseqty  +  receiptqty  -  issueqty  -   adjdecreaseqty  -   purchasereturnqty  -   saleqty  -  saltisfyqty  ) * saleprice  for all)

objects.name: compute_12
objects.visible: 1	if( (itemopeningstock  +  saleretqty  +  purchaseqty  +  adjincreaseqty  +  receiptqty  -  issueqty  -   adjdecreaseqty  -   purchasereturnqty  -  saleretqty )=0 ,0,1)

objects.name: compute_13
objects.visible: 1	if( (itemopeningstock  +  saleretqty  +  purchaseqty  +  adjincreaseqty  +  receiptqty  -  issueqty  -   adjdecreaseqty  -   purchasereturnqty  -  saleretqty )=0 ,0,1)
objects.expression: ( itemopeningstock  +  saleretqty  +  purchaseqty  +  adjincreaseqty  +  receiptqty  -  issueqty  -   adjdecreaseqty  -   purchasereturnqty  -   saleqty   -  saltisfyqty ) * saleprice

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: sum(( itemopeningstock  +  saleretqty  +  purchaseqty  +  adjincreaseqty  +  receiptqty  -  issueqty  -   adjdecreaseqty  -   purchasereturnqty  -   saleqty  -  saltisfyqty  ) * saleprice  for group 1)
